programme.title: Boo Moon
programme.desc: Casper emerges from a subway station, following a crowd of scared strangers. He encounters a man saying "see the wonders of the moon for ten cents," and offering a sight through a telescope. Casper scares the man away, then uses the telescope to see the moon. He then flies to the moon for a visit. Casper lands on the moon, disappointed to find no man on the moon. He lies down to nap, then tiny moon men emerge from holes. They capture Casper, like Lilliputians did to Gulliver, then place him in a cage on wheels, in which they tow him to the Ruler of the Moon, King Luna. The King addresses Casper as a monster, and treats him as an enemy. Casper playfully picks up King Luna, and the king has him placed in the royal dungeon. A dejected Casper is imprisoned. Then animated trees attack the city of the moon men. The moon men defend their fortified city with flaming missiles. The tree monsters fight back with water, then break through the town walls. When the fight seems lost to the tree monsters, Casper escapes his cage, and helps the moon men. Casper goes underground. The friendly ghost then pulls trees' parts through the moon surface and ties them together, immobilizing the trees. The frustrated trees writhe and strain against the knots Casper has tied. Casper and the moon men have won. Then, and only then, does King Luna embrace Casper as a friend. King Luna knights Casper for the valiant defense of his people. Then all the moon men join in singing the Casper theme song.

programme.title: Bride and Gloom

programme.title: Lights Fantastic 1942

programme.title: The Friendly Ghost 1945

They take him home, where Casper frightens their mother. Casper is again upset because he believes that he will always scare away his potential buddies. However, Casper scares away a banker who is coming to foreclose on the woman's house, and this wins her heart for Casper.

programme.title: Noah's Ark 1959
programme.desc: Noah gets the word: build an ark in seven days. His sons cut the necessary trees in three days, and much furious sawing and hammering follows. But there's no rest, as they need to round up all the animals. Noah boards the animals, then his sons, their wives, and his wife (who packed a ferocious picnic). The rains and flood begin. The animals soon develop cabin fever and get restless, but Mrs. Noah has the answer: "Music has charms to soothe the savage beast." His sons find instruments and begin playing; everyone dances. But Harry the hippo dances with everyone but his wife; Noah goes to her, and while she tells him not to mention Harry's name, Noah convinces her that Harry is thinking only of her. The rains end; Noah sends a dove out who brings back an olive branch. They land on Mount Ararat and disembark.

programme.title: Boo Moon
programme.desc: Casper emerges from a subway station, following a crowd of scared strangers. He encounters a man saying "see the wonders of the moon for ten cents," and offering a sight through a telescope. Casper scares the man away, then uses the telescope to see the moon. He then flies to the moon for a visit. Casper lands on the moon, disappointed to find no man on the moon. He lies down to nap, then tiny moon men emerge from holes. They capture Casper, like Lilliputians did to Gulliver, then place him in a cage on wheels, in which they tow him to the Ruler of the Moon, King Luna. The King addresses Casper as a monster, and treats him as an enemy. Casper playfully picks up King Luna, and the king has him placed in the royal dungeon. A dejected Casper is imprisoned. Then animated trees attack the city of the moon men. The moon men defend their fortified city with flaming missiles. The tree monsters fight back with water, then break through the town walls. When the fight seems lost to the tree monsters, Casper escapes his cage, and helps the moon men. Casper goes underground. The friendly ghost then pulls trees' parts through the moon surface and ties them together, immobilizing the trees. The frustrated trees writhe and strain against the knots Casper has tied. Casper and the moon men have won. Then, and only then, does King Luna embrace Casper as a friend. King Luna knights Casper for the valiant defense of his people. Then all the moon men join in singing the Casper theme song.

programme.title: It's Hummer Time 1950
programme.desc: A cat chases a hummingbird and repeatedly stumbles onto the property of a sleepy bulldog, who punishes the cat for each interruption of his slumber.

programme.title: Betty Boop- Whoops! I'm a Cowboy-1937
programme.desc: Betty Boop's runt of a suitor thinks he'll have better luck if he takes cowboy lessons at a dude ranch; slapstick results.

programme.title: I Never Changes My Altitude 1937
programme.desc: Popeye is sitting outside Olive's lunchroom at the airport, distraught. She's closed the business to fly away with an aviator (Bluto, of course). But it's hardly what she expected; he has her painting his plane, while it's flying; when she says she's rather go back to Popeye, he tries to throw her off the plane. Popeye sees this, and takes off in a plane, just in time to help her out. The boys get into a dogfight, and Bluto manages to demolish Popeye's plane. As Popeye is falling, he grabs a duck and feeds the duck spinach. The duck manages to fly him up to Bluto's plane, Popeye has some spinach of his own, and he teaches Bluto a lesson. Popeye picks up Olive and crashes the plane into the diner, opening it (and providing a new counter).

programme.title: Betty Boop- The Scared Crows 1939
programme.desc: Betty Boop and Pudgy, doing the spring planting, are plagued by crows.

programme.title: The Booze Hangs High-1930
programme.desc: Bosko has a grand time on the farm, dancing with a cow, playing a horse's tail like a violin and getting drunk with three pigs

programme.title: Bride and Gloom
programme.desc: Popeye is marrying Olive tomorrow; he's ecstatic. She has a dream of the future, including twin sons who prove to be a real handful. When Popeye comes by the next morning, he gets a frosty reception

programme.title: Balloon Land-1935
programme.desc: The inhabitants, including the trees and rocks, of Balloon Land are made entirely of balloons. They come under attack from the evil Pincushion Man. With the help of a quickly inflated army, they manage to fend off the attack.

programme.title: Fireman's Life, A-1933

programme.title: Felix Minds the Kid 1922
programme.desc: After unsuccessfully trying to steal food from a fish market, Felix is promised by a man that if he watches the man's child, he will be fed a great meal. Unfortunately, the baby swallows a balloon and floats out the window, and Felix has to find him and bring him back before the man gets home.

programme.title: Floor Flusher 1954
programme.desc: Popeye and Bluto stop by to see Olive and fix her leaky faucet. Popeye does it better, and Bluto gets jealous, so he starts rerouting Olive's plumbing and causing all sorts of leaks. Popeye needs some help from the goldfish to get to his spinach

programme.title: Gulangyu Island
programme.desc: Gulangyu Island is famous for its exotic architecture. As a key trade port in the late 19th and early 20th centuries, it was a gathering point for merchants and diplomats from all over the world. This led to a variety of architectural styles being adopted on the island, including a fusion of Chinese and Western designs, as well as some typical of the Chaozhou region. These buildings, mostly over 100 years old, stand witness to China's reconnection with the outside world.

programme.title: Rhythms of the Forest: A Sound of Li Instruments
programme.desc: Li bamboo and wood instruments offer a journey into the unique sounds of Hainan's Li ethnic group. Explore the ancient craftsmanship and musical heritage, from the resonant tones of bamboo flutes to the percussive rhythms of wooden drums. Experience the natural melodies that tell the stories of the Li people.

programme.title: Foodwise: The Herbal Way of Life
programme.desc: 'Medicine tonic is not as good as food tonic' - this Chinese saying is a core principle of Traditional Chinese Medicine. It is believed that the right diet and nourishment can cure and reverse the effects of disease, hence considered an inevitable source of natural health preservation. In this Foodwise episode, our hosts Tianran He and Eva May explore this ancient concept of medicine food homology as they taste their way through different herbs, chat to experts of Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) and visit venues that combine conventional principles with modern ideas. Dive deep into the origin of TCM with us as we learn about the harmony between man and nature and its application in modern functional foods!

programme.title: Foodwise: Xilingol
programme.desc: The Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region is located in the northern part of China, stretching from northeast to southwest side. In Xilin Gol, the horses, sheep and cows could be found every where. The local cuisines here are so attractive to the tourists, such as the roasted lamb is a traditional local dish. And the fired stone fried lamb is so hard to find if you are not traveling to Inner Mongolia. Have you ever tried salted milk tea? Just join in this visual trip！

programme.title: Foodwise: Kunming
programme.desc: Join host Tianran He in Kunming, the capital of Yunnan province in southwest China. Named the Spring City for its perennially good weather, Kunming is one of China's most ethnically diverse cities, something that's reflected in its food: From boozy sticky rice for breakfast, to the famous "Crossing the Bridge" rice noodles, and evening barbecues, there's plenty on offer here. Also, it's mushroom season, and Tianran is taking to the hills to hunt for wild fungi – but he'll need a trusty friend to steer him away from the poisonous ones!

programme.title: Foodwise: The Taste of Home
programme.desc: In this episode, our hosts Tianran He and Eva May eat their way down memory lane across virtual space and different time zones, and embark on a culinary journey at their birthplace. Eva rediscovers her love for a classic century-old dish in her hometown Vienna and introduces Austria's long-lasting coffeehouse culture to Tianran, who also joins her virtually for an evening with friends and food the traditional Viennese way. Meanwhile, Beijing's charming autumn season sets Tianran back in time as he rediscovers flavors from his childhood. His passion for tea might have even started in one of the old tea shops in Beijing's hutongs, recollecting his memories one sip at a time, accompanied by nostalgic meals and a relaxed stroll under yellow gingko trees.

programme.title: Foodwise: Shaoxing
programme.desc: Join host Tianran He in the historic water town of Shaoxing, famed for its yellow wine. Traversing its canals by boat, Tianran discovers why it's said there are 10,000 bridges in Shaoxing, before enjoying the freshest catch of the day. But as it turns out, Shaoxing's climate is also perfect for fermentation, leading to a wide array of unique local foods that can sometimes be both smelly and delicious – and at other times, downright unforgettable!

programme.title: China, Race to the Future Ep.4
programme.desc: This five-episode series explores China's growing cultural confidence, showing how a revival of traditional culture is fueling "chain reactions" that are reshaping Chinese manufacturing and development. In particular, the series stresses how China’s immense cultural capital is empowering a uniquely Chinese approach to building a future that puts openness, globalization and the environment center-stage!

programme.title: Wudang Martial Arts and Taichi
programme.desc: Join host Yegor on a journey into the heart of China’s Wudang Mountains—the spiritual cradle of Taoism and the birthplace of Wudang martial arts. Through in-depth conversations with renowned masters such as Zhong Xueyong, Cai Chongguang, Jake Pinnick, and Liu Xiang, this episode explores the philosophy, techniques, and living spirit of Wudang Quan and Taichi. From the internal cultivation of qi to the harmony between body and mind, Wudang martial arts are more than just physical training—they are a way of life rooted in the Tao. Alongside martial techniques, the program also delves into traditional Chinese music, calligraphy, and medicine, revealing how these disciplines come together in the pursuit of balance, self-awareness, and longevity. This is not just a story of punches and postures, but of tradition, transformation, and the timeless search for harmony between humans and the universe.

programme.title: Ding Porcelain Firing
programme.desc: In ancient times, skilled craftsmen combined clay with fire and, using nothing more than their hands and wisdom, created the history of porcelain. A thousand years ago, at the time of the Northern Song Dynasty, a type of porcelain was produced that stood out for its exquisite quality, elegant coloring and beautiful patterns. This was Ding porcelain, and it became a favorite at the imperial court. However, within 200 years, amid the chaos of constant warfare, the art of making it was lost. The dazzling white light of the Ding kilns had faded, seemingly forever. And yet, 800 years later, that light has been reignited.

programme.title: Gulangyu Island
programme.desc: Gulangyu Island is famous for its exotic architecture. As a key trade port in the late 19th and early 20th centuries, it was a gathering point for merchants and diplomats from all over the world. This led to a variety of architectural styles being adopted on the island, including a fusion of Chinese and Western designs, as well as some typical of the Chaozhou region. These buildings, mostly over 100 years old, stand witness to China's reconnection with the outside world.

programme.title: Rhythms of the Forest: A Sound of Li Instruments
programme.desc: Li bamboo and wood instruments offer a journey into the unique sounds of Hainan's Li ethnic group. Explore the ancient craftsmanship and musical heritage, from the resonant tones of bamboo flutes to the percussive rhythms of wooden drums. Experience the natural melodies that tell the stories of the Li people.

programme.title: Foodwise: The Herbal Way of Life
programme.desc: 'Medicine tonic is not as good as food tonic' - this Chinese saying is a core principle of Traditional Chinese Medicine. It is believed that the right diet and nourishment can cure and reverse the effects of disease, hence considered an inevitable source of natural health preservation. In this Foodwise episode, our hosts Tianran He and Eva May explore this ancient concept of medicine food homology as they taste their way through different herbs, chat to experts of Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) and visit venues that combine conventional principles with modern ideas. Dive deep into the origin of TCM with us as we learn about the harmony between man and nature and its application in modern functional foods!

programme.title: Foodwise: Haikou
programme.desc: Welcome to Haikou, also known as the Coconut City! Join Tianran He in experiencing the unique culinary culture and urban character of this tropical paradise. From light and sweet coconut chicken hotpot to refreshing herbal desserts and spicy rice soup - a local favourite, every bite tells the story of the city's laid-back charm and beauty. We'll explore everything from Haikou's winding alleys and mangrove forests, to the culture of its southeast Asian diaspora, so come and discover this magical destination with us.

programme.title: Foodwise: Hainan's Four Famous Dishes
programme.desc: The stunning east coast of Hainan in southeast China, attract numerous visitors to travel. The reason that people tend to visit Hianan not only because of the beautiful beach view but also delicious local cuisine in Hainan. Hainan’s four famous dishes is Chicken, duck, goat and crab. In Wenchang, the ancestral home of many overseas Chinese, people could discover the original version of Hainan Chicken Rice and see how local chickens free range on coconut meat. In Qionghai, seat of the Boao Forum for Asia, you may dine on duck and goat, before feasting on crab in the surfer haven of Wanning.

programme.title: Foodwise: Xishuangbanna Ep.1
programme.desc: What's not to love about Xishuangbanna? From dazzling night markets to lush bamboo forests, 800-year old tea trees to close encounters with elephants, this tropical city in southwest China has everything, and is where the story of tea begins. Join Foodwise for all the Pu'er tea you can drink and feast on everything from banana flowers to "elephant food"!

programme.title: Foodwise: Xishuangbanna Ep.2
programme.desc: Come get soaked at the Dai people's New Year celebrations! We'll check out buzzing street markets packed with barbecued meats and spicy fruits, crash a foodie auction, and even take part in a rowdy competition, catching fish with our bare hands in the river. All this before hiking through an actual rainforest. We're going to need all the good tea and food we can get!

programme.title: Foodwise: Huangshan Ep.1
programme.desc: Tianran and Hannah climb Mount.Huangshan, one of China's most famous mountains, sampling its delicate green tea and the rich flavors of Anhui cuisine, and explore the region's ancient villages and lush bamboo forests featured in the blockbuster film "Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon".

programme.title: China, Race to the Future Ep.5
programme.desc: This five-episode series explores China's growing cultural confidence, showing how a revival of traditional culture is fueling "chain reactions" that are reshaping Chinese manufacturing and development. In particular, the series stresses how China’s immense cultural capital is empowering a uniquely Chinese approach to building a future that puts openness, globalization and the environment center-stage!

programme.title: Culture Forward
programme.desc: Culture Forward is set at a pivotal moment between the close of China’s 14th Five-Year Plan and the launch of the 15th. The program explores how technology is giving culture new momentum, featuring cases such as Guizhou’s mechanized batik techniques, the digital presentation of Liangzhu culture, AI-powered design for Miao embroidery, and creative innovation at the Hunan Museum. Through real-world practices, it reveals how traditional Chinese culture is being revitalized in the age of intelligence—moving toward a future that is more open, innovative, and high-quality.

programme.title: The sound of casting
programme.desc: For centuries, the fires of craftsmanship have never faded in Pingyao. In this UNESCO World Heritage city once famed for trade, three ancient metalworking traditions — sword casting, gold and silver crafting, and iron forging — continue to thrive. This episode steps into the workshops where artisans shape metal with fire and devotion. Each blade’s edge, each ornament’s gleam, and each curve of wrought iron tells a story of resilience and artistry — revealing how the spirit of Pingyao’s craftsmanship still glows in the heart of time.

programme.title: Indigo Dreams: A Hue of Dali Tie-dye
programme.desc: Dali Tie-dye is the unique textile art of the Bai people, renowned for its exquisite hand-tying and traditional indigo dyeing techniques that create brilliant, one-of-a-kind patterns. Explore the cultural heritage and enduring beauty of this ancient craft from Yunnan.

programme.title: Mount Wutai, Embracing the Wonders of Nature
programme.desc: Mount Wutai, in the northeastern part of Shanxi Province, is one of the Four Great Buddhist Mountains of China. It is a magnet for tourists, who are drawn here not only by its profound Buddhist cultural heritage, but also by the spectacular natural scenery. Mount Wutai is noted for its unique topography, marked by five flattened peaks. Hence the name "Wutai," or “Five Terraces.” The five, each with its own characteristics and distinct shape, are Wanghai East Peak, Guayue West Peak, Jinxiu South Peak, Yedou North Peak, and Cuiyan Central Peak. Soaring into the clouds, together they resemble a magnificent work crafted by nature.

At the Keeneland Racetrack they sip some spirit forward Keeneland Breezes while Elsa reveals all she has learned about racehorses from a visit to renowned trainer Mark Simms Jr. ‘s horse barn. A Betologist gives them a quick lesson on wagering and Kimberly’s horse wins the race. At Louisville’s Trouble Bar, Kimberly shares her newfound knowledge of Kentucky bourbon production from a tour and tasting at Castle + Key distillery and makes Elsa One Perfect Drink.

programme.title: Cycling home from China Eng
programme.desc: Josh spent 4 months self filming his bike trip home from the Giant bike factory in Shanghai. During his 15 000 km trip between Shanghai China and Newcastle UK, he crossed 19 countries. A fantastic human adventure and a unique bike trip !

programme.title: 12th Longines Equestrian Beijing Masters 2025
programme.desc: China. Beijing. A city where history breathes through every stone and shimmer of steel. Here, where dynasties once rode across vast plains, a new kind of cavalry takes the stage riders of precision, courage, and grace. Each autumn, the National Stadium, the Bird’s Nest transforms. Where Olympic legends once soared, hooves now thunder. This is the Longines Beijing Masters — the heart of Asian equestrian sport, and a meeting place for the world’s finest.

programme.title: Mongolia Horseback Archery World Championships 2023
programme.desc: For 2023, Mongolia and its capital Ulaanbaatar was brought in the spotlight of official horseback archery competition, that has grown a lot over the last few years in many places around the world. Everything started with the Spirit International HBA tournament in the beginning of September and this event would set the stage for the pinnacle one that was about to follow: the 2023 International Horse Archery Alliance World Championships.

programme.title: UIPM 2025 Obstacle World Championships
programme.desc: Beijing’s Olympic Centre turns into a proving ground as the UIPM Obstacle World Championships crown new stars across the 400 m, 3 K, and blistering 100 m sprint.

programme.title: Hokkaido Japan by bike - Part 3 Eng
programme.desc: Our bikepacker friend Michele is exploring the Japanese island of Hokkaido. On the agenda: volcanoes, forests, wilderness, brown bears, fishing owls, the Pacific Ocean, and weather that isnt always kind. Episode 3.

programme.title: UK Challenge 2025
programme.desc: Talent can win you the game, but its intelligence and teamwork that will win you the championship once, said the NBA basketball legend. That is Michael Jordan and hes right. And in this case, its the seven individual stages that are the games and the overall championship is the 2025 UK challenge. For the next three days and nights, nearly 70 teams will be putting themselves through what is the most mentally and physically demanding team building competition that youll see anywhere, and theyre all doing it for the challenge of building teamwork and the acclaim of picking up that overall Winners Trophy.

programme.title: The Outdoor Sports Show 2025 - Christmas Special Edition
programme.desc: We start this episode from Romania. In our previous episodes, we covered the exciting 2025 edition of Brasov Running Festival, highlighting the effort of the Elite 10k athletes. However, the Brasov Running Festival is much more than just the elite competitors. We then shift our focus to cycling, moving on to Turkey for another edition of LÉtape Türkiye by Tour de France. Moving from Turkey, we catch a flight to Croatia for Spartan Trail Dubrovnik. Since this is the last episode of the TV Show for 2025, we also got a glimpse of some of the most notable moments we enjoyed over the previous months.

programme.title: The First Second - Michi Wohlleben
programme.desc: «The higher you raise the bar the further you fall down!”. Michi language is made of very strong, singular sentences, as sharpened as his climbing style. His sentences try to define himself, without worrying about himself, by thwarting clichés… but do not succeed in really finding himself. On the other hand his words create beautiful images that show Michis inspiration, fluidity, and pleasure in action. Through the discovery of his goals and his gamble with the risk, Michi mixes both quest and primal pleasure.

programme.title: Skoda Titan Desert Almeria 2025
programme.desc: Four intense days of mountain biking through Almería’s stunning landscapes — from coast to desert, across sand, hills, and rugged trails. Amateurs and pros alike face the heat, the wind, and their own limits. More than a race, it’s an adventure of endurance, camaraderie, and pure adrenaline beyond the stopwatch.

programme.title: Cape To Cape 2025 Eng
programme.desc: 800 riders have assembled for the 17th edition of the Australian Cape To Cape mountain bike stage race. Starting at Cape Leeuwin lighthouse and finishing four days later up at Cape Naturaliste, the course makes its way through a network of trails along the coast, through National Parks, forest, farm lands, mountain bike parks, and bush before heading up to the northern cape of the South West WA region. Roughly 200km and 2,500m of climbing in total, each day’s riding is between 34km and 59km and has its own special terrain and environment to keep things interesting with a mix of fast flowing single trail, farm tracks, groomed downhill trails and fire trails.

programme.title: Nedbank Gravel Burn 2025
programme.desc: Nedbank Gravel Burn is a 7-day, 800km full-service gravel stage race through South Africa’s diverse landscapes. Starting in coastal forests, the route heads into the breathtaking Great Karoo – a vast, spectacular semi-desert region. Riders rest each night in remote ‘Burn Camps’ under star-filled skies and, on the final day, greeted by Africa’s iconic Big 5 wildlife.

programme.title: Santos Tour Down Under Women 2026
programme.desc: 9th edition of the Womens Tour Down Under, which is the part of the 2026 UCI Womens World Tour.

programme.title: Cro Race 2025
programme.desc: The 2025 CRO Race is a road cycling stage race (6 stages - 900 km) in Croatia held between 30 September and 5 October 2025. It is the tenth edition of the Tour of Croatia since its revival in 2015 and the sixth under the CRO Race name. The race is rated as a category 2.1 event on the 2025 UCI Europe Tour calendar

programme.title: Inside Desertus Bikus Eng
programme.desc: Josh partcipates to Desertus Bikus, an ultra cycling race that crosses Spain and Portugal starting in Hasparren in the Basque Country and finishing in Setubal Portugal. Josh is cycling during 1400 km across desert areas, villages, gravel tracks and asphalt roads.

programme.title: 2025 Aus Cycling MTB Enduro National Championships
programme.desc: A rain-soaked Collie, Western Australia, becomes the stage for Australia’s premier Enduro showdown, where world-class Wambenger Trails and the iconic Wellington Dam mural frame a weekend of grit, flow and community. Across Juniors, Masters, Adaptive and E-bike fields, riders wrestle slick rock, pea gravel and long liaison climbs as stories of resilience emerge. The result is a kinetic, human-centred portrait of Australian MTB: fast, muddy, inclusive, and unforgettable.

programme.title: Nastro Rosa Tour 2025 Eng
programme.desc: The Marina Militare Nastro Rosa Tour returns in 2025 for its fifth edition, offering a unique journey that blends high-level competition with Italy’s maritime culture and coastal beauty. Since its debut in 2021, the Tour has grown into more than a sailing event—it has become a travelling festival of the sea, connecting athletes, coastal cities, and local communities in a shared celebration of sport, heritage, and discovery.

programme.title: GKA Kite-Surf World Cup Dakhla - Morocco 2025
programme.desc: A full roster of 28 men and 16 women, from a total of 16 countries around the world, are set to join the line-up in Dakhla for five days of intense action that could have a key bearing on who takes the titles. Reigning world champions, France’s Capucine Delannoy and Brazil’s Gabriel Benetton, top the Kite-Surf rankings as they head to the season’s penultimate stop in Dakhla, Morocco, on the Sahara desert’s coastline.

programme.title: SFT Wake Foil E-Foil World Cup Abu Dhabi 2025
programme.desc: Abu Dhabi, the capital of the United Arab Emirates, will make history this autumn as it hosts the GWA Wingfoil World Cup for the first time, marking the grand finale of the 2025 FreeFly-Slalom season. Leading the charge are two-time defending world champions, Nia Suardiaz, of Spain, and Francesco Cappuzzo, of Italy, who head to Abu Dhabi leading the rankings. With the season’s final stop still wide open, both athletes will need flawless performances to secure their third consecutive titles.

programme.title: GKA Kite-Surf World Cup Taiba - Brazil 2025
programme.desc: Taíba, Brazil, host the final stop of the GKA Kite World Tour 2025. The world’s top riders will take to Taíba’s powerful Atlantic waves for four days of action-packed competition that will determine the men’s and women’s world titles. The event marks the thrilling conclusion to a season that has already visited Cape Verde, Dakhla, and Sylt.

programme.title: The First Second - Armel Le Cl ac h E
programme.desc: Armel Le Cléach creates his victories thanks to a strong relationship with the whole team of which he is the extension ... But for this navigator engaged in a daunting battle with the ocean on a giant 32-meter trimaran, each course towards a new start is a new battle with the unknown, with his own will and with his primary adversary: himself.

programme.title: The First Second - Samantha Davies
programme.desc: Samantha Davies sees the ocean as a pleasure, obvious. In symbiosis with her boat, she leads a violent struggle with the harsh conditions and "loves it" in an almost inexplicable way! She knows and enjoys her luck, which she shares with Initiatives Cœur. She also measures it to that of her grandfather, a war submariner…. At the start of a race like the Vendée Globe, it is an adventurer who sets off.

programme.title: Inside Sailing 2025 - Episode 12
programme.desc: In our previous episode Italy was on the spotlight. The world’s top WingFoil racers were building up towards the most important event of the season, the first ever Formula Wing World Championships. We also attended Dutch Water Week, that is the premier celebration of sport and water in Netherlands. We will start this episode from Brazil where the Wingfoil Racing World Cup roared back to life on Brazil’s north-east coast, launching its season finale. We will also travel to Turkey, where the Bosphorus turned into a sea of color and pride as the 6th Presidential International Yacht Races concluded with its grand finale. Leaving action aside, we will travel to Malta for for the Malta Boat Show.

programme.title: GKA Freestyle Kite World Cup Taiba - Brazil 2025
programme.desc: The second and final call of the GKA Freestyle season is set to play out in the sumptuous conditions of Brazil’s Taíba lagoon, where the 2025 world champions will be crowned. The world championship titles are in the balance after the opening stop in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates, several weeks ago, ended inconclusively when the wind declined to play ball for the freestylers. That effectively makes the GKA Freestyle Kite World Cup Taíba 2025 a one-stop world championship for the 2025 titles, leaving no margin for slip-ups from leading contenders, who are all in Brazil.

programme.title: GKA Freestyle World Cup Abu Dhabi 2025
programme.desc: Abu Dhabi will host the GKA Kite World Tour for the first time, bringing back-to-back World Cups in Hydrofoil Big Air and Freestyle to Fahid Island, Abu Dhabi’s newest coastal wellness destination and the world’s first Fitwel-certified island, offering 11kms of coastline.

programme.title: Changing Channels
programme.desc: Gerrard Gosens is set to become the first totally blind person to attempt the daunting 34+ km swim from Dover in the UK to Cape Gris-Nez in France. Battling the cold and unpredictable waters of the English Channel, Gerrard faces not only the rough conditions but also the need to swim in synchronization with his team of guide swimmers, Hayden, Phil, Jo, Rosie, Alexis, and Sarah by his side.

programme.title: All The Way Eng
programme.desc: From award-winning documentary filmmaker Carl Eneroth at Sthlm Social Innovation Lab comes "All the Way". A heart-pounding, intimate and mind expanding portrait of Swimrun team Pontus Lindberg and George Bjälkemo, as they prepare for their ultimate challenge… winning the 75 km ÖtillÖ Swimrun World Championships in the Stockholm archipelago… in trail shoes and a wetsuit.

programme.title: 2025 ROLEX New York Yacht Club Invitational Cup
programme.desc: Twenty teams from 12 countries would compete in the ninth Rolex New York Yacht Club Invitational Cup, the biennial regatta hosted by the New York Yacht Club Harbour Court in Newport, R.I. Since the event was first run in 2009, it has attracted top amateur sailors from 51 of the world’s most prestigious yacht clubs from 23 countries.

programme.title: Moana Waiwai - The Film
programme.desc: Moana Waiwai or The Great Ocean in Maori, is about the FreeSwim journey of wahine (woman) Ally Davey as she swims 70km of open ocean around the stunning Coromandel coastline over three days to raise awareness for the protection of New Zealands oceans. It does more than encapsulate stunning vistas and highlight the extraordinary New Zealand environment. It inspires people to be aware of the natural beauty that surrounds them.

programme.title: World Rookie Freeski Finals 2025
programme.desc: The World Rookie Tour is excited that the Freeski Finals are held in the magnificent Ursus Snowpark at Madonna di Campiglio. This event shows the world’s most talented young freeski athletes as they compete in one of the most celebrated snowparks in Europe. This exclusive opportunity brings the excitement and competitive spirit of one of the most anticipated events in youth action sports directly to athletes, fans and viewers.

programme.title: A Feather in the West
programme.desc: In September 2019, a team of talented Irish climbers [Chloe Condron, Kevin Kilroy, Michelle OLoughlin and Conor McGovern] travelled to the small island of Owey to explore sea cliffs that local guidebook writer Iain Miller claims, have “enough new routing potential to last at least twelve lifetimes”. ‘A Feather in the West’ is a film about their trad climbing experiences and the relatively niche pursuit of first ascents, set on the Wild Atlantic Way, off the west coast of County Donegal. (Special thanks to Pertex)

programme.title: Skiing China Exploring Altai Mountains
programme.desc: A quartet of champion skiers and snowboarders from Australia and the USA visit the unexplored Altai Frontier in China, now believed to be the place where skiing first developed, more than 10,000 years ago. They encounter the ancient culture of the region and explore the spectacular local slopes, using their own hi-tech equipment as well as the traditional skis manufactured by local craftsmen using age-old practices. The four visitors, Scott Kneller, Jari Hiatt, Halina Boyd and Harry Kearney, all of whom have world-beating careers in snowboarding, skiing and ski mountaineering, discover new challenges and new frontiers in China’s remote north-western province.

programme.title: Nine Mountains
programme.desc: The journey of two cyclists (Leo Russell & George Stagg) on a mission to climb the 9 most challenging and notorious mountains in Europe. From Austria To Spain, Nine Mountains is an adventure of brutality and beauty exploring the limits of the mind and body. The boys cycled over 3,200km from blistering snowstorms to scorching deserts whilst ascending the equivalent of eight times the height of Everest. The film follows a never been done route with the aim to raise £100,000 towards mens mental health charity James Place, an organisation set up to help men in suicidal crisis.

programme.title: Alone And Without A Guide On Mexico s Third Highest Mountain-Iztaccihuatl Eng
programme.desc: Being alone and without a guide in a summit attempt for the third highest mountain in Mexico was a dream. The climb is amazing. The ridge to Iztaccihuatls summit feels endless, but the views of the surrounding valleys and Popocatepetl make the effort worth it.

programme.title: Nendaz Backcountry Invitational 2025
programme.desc: Nestled in the heart of the Swiss Alps, the Nendaz Backcountry Invitational 2025 is one of the most exciting events on the freeride calendar. This unique competition brings together some of the world’s top backcountry athletes, showcasing their incredible skills and creativity in untouched snow.

programme.title: Grand Teton Loop Eng
programme.desc: Grand Teton National Park is a stunning and iconic park in the US, known for its majestic Teton Range, beautiful lakes, and diverse wildlife. In July of 2022, Jeff and Audrée made a stop on their way back to Canada while on a road trip to Colorado, so that they could run a 38 mile / 62 km loop around the park, which mile for mile would be one of the most scenic and beautiful routes theyve ever run.

programme.title: Lekkarod 2025
programme.desc: Depuis 10 ans, la Lekkarod est une course majeure du mushing en Europe. Affiliée aux fédérations nationale FFST et internationale IFSS, elle est une étape de la Coupe du Monde. Chaque année, une centaine de mushers et leurs chiens prennent le départ des 9 étapes de la Lekkarod, ou de celles des Trophées !For the past 10 years, the Lekkarod has been a major mushing race in Europe. Affiliated with the national FFST and international IFSS federations, it is a stage of the World Cup. Each year, around a hundred mushers and their dogs take part in the 9 stages of the Lekkarod, or those of the Trophies!

programme.title: Summiting Mt Sneffels in Colorado Eng
programme.desc: Mount Sneffels is a prominent mountain near Ouray, Colorado in the United States which is over 14,000 feet high, more than 4,300 metres. Audree had never climbed a 14er, so we decided to try reach its summit while on a road trip through Colorado in late-July.

programme.title: Best Via Ferrata In The Dolomites Climbing Possnecker Eng
programme.desc: Cris and Viv climb Piz Selva, a 2,941m mountain belonging to the Sella group, an iconic giant of the Dolomites.They start their hike from Passo Sella, and their chosen route was via Ferrata Possnecker (also called Ferrata delle Mesules), one of the oldest Via Ferratas in the Dolomites.

programme.title: The Rise of the Hamminator Lindsey Hamm s journey from concrete to peaks
programme.desc: Mammut athlete Lindsey Hamm, a professional climber and mountain guide, brings a breath of fresh air to the world of mountaineering. Originally from Texas, she has begun making a name for herself in recent years. This short film offers a glimpse into her life, a recent expedition to Pakistan’s wild Charakusa Valley. Beyond the mountains, Lindsey is a people person, driven by a passion for inclusivity in climbing, and giving opportunities to other women, who want to get into the sport. She collaborates with womens organizations in Pakistan, helping to dismantle barriers and create opportunities for education and growth.

programme.title: Margalef - Climbing
programme.desc: Margalef is a little village next to the Monsant river, in Catalunya. The most amazing rocks in Europe and hundreds routes for climbing. Pure fun and climbing in this little entertaining film.

programme.title: Nendaz Backcountry Invitational 2025
programme.desc: Nestled in the heart of the Swiss Alps, the Nendaz Backcountry Invitational 2025 is one of the most exciting events on the freeride calendar. This unique competition brings together some of the world’s top backcountry athletes, showcasing their incredible skills and creativity in untouched snow.

programme.title: The High
programme.desc: THE HIGH is a feature length documentary film about the making of the longest high altitude foot race in the world. The film follows the path of a group of extreme runners who individually decide to take part of a dangerous running experiment gone wrong. Indian race director Rajat Chauhan works against the advice of the military, his family and friends to create a race over the two highest passes in the world (above 17 500ft). The decline begins from the start, with runners collapsing from dehydration, hypothermia, and high-altitude sickness. And by its end finds the entire race in jeopardy and the prospect that no one finishes. Brought to life by archive footage, story recreations, and interviews, the film unfolds the events in the Himalayas of Northern India and gives a unique look into the lives of the extreme marathon runners involved. Uncovering the avalanches, athletes, and the high altitude elements. THE HIGH shows the rewards of determination, the dangers of obsession, and in the end leaves you with the answer of why they called it, the toughest race on earth. Directed by Barry Walton.

programme.title: Raid Gallaecia 2025
programme.desc: In the frontier between Galicia and northern Portugal, adventure racing returned to one of Europe’s most unspoiled regions with Raid Gallaecia 2025. Over five days and nearly 500 kilometers, 28 international teams battled mountains, forests, rivers, and exhaustion in a non-stop race of strategy, endurance, and teamwork.

programme.title: Raid Gallaecia 2025
programme.desc: In the frontier between Galicia and northern Portugal, adventure racing returned to one of Europe’s most unspoiled regions with Raid Gallaecia 2025. Over five days and nearly 500 kilometers, 28 international teams battled mountains, forests, rivers, and exhaustion in a non-stop race of strategy, endurance, and teamwork.

programme.title: Golden Trail World Series 2025 Season Recap - Unfinished Business Eng
programme.desc: This exclusive episode offers fans a fresh and emotional look back at the season, featuring the most thrilling moments, behind-the-scenes insights, and never-before-seen interviews with the athletes who defined the year.

programme.title: Trail Menorca Cami De Cavalls 2025
programme.desc: Welcome to a new edition of the Trail Menorca Camí de Cavalls Conecta Balear. 185 kilometers tracing the edge of a millennia-old island, blessed with unique natural beauty. Enchanted trails, towering cliffs, and dreamlike beaches shape one of the most demanding routes in the Mediterranean.

programme.title: New Zealand 9
programme.desc: In a race against time, three adventurers will set a new speed record by completing New Zealand’s nine Great Walks faster than they’ve ever been done before, using human power alone. It’s the ultimate adventure race. They’ll kayak 145 km, ride 80 km and run over 300 km in just nine days.

programme.title: Challenge Family 2025 - Season Wrap Up Eng
programme.desc: Since its founding, the Challenge Family triathlon series has redefined the spirit of endurance sports. Known for its unique courses, passionate community, and athlete-centered values, Challenge Family offers races in some of the world’s most iconic locations. From the breathtaking landscapes to the demands of each event, Challenge Family is about more than just competition. It’s about athletes pushing beyond their limits, fueled by the support of fans, family, and each other. Through the journeys of athletes, everyone can understand what it takes to prepare, to overcome, and to race with a purpose that goes far beyond the finish line.

programme.title: Ultra Vegans
programme.desc: For endurance athletes, getting the right diet can make the difference between success and failure. Many are now choosing to adopt a plant based regime and they are witnessing some remarkable results in terms of performance and recovery. Athletes, fitness coaches, sports nutritionists, ultra runners are sharing with us their experience and conviction wether they are motivated by self performance or animal wellfare.

programme.title: The First Second - Geraldine Fasnacht
programme.desc: When Geraldine, the bird woman puts on her mask, we know that the images of the pink wingsuit will be closer to poetry than adrenaline! Several snowboard world championship titles, more than 3200 jumps, but at the start, how do you decide to ride and fly all your life?

programme.title: The Road Ahead
programme.desc: Fredrik Erixon, a passionate adventurer crosses Sweden on roller skis from the north in Karesuando in Lappland, to Smygehuk in Skane in the south – a solo journey of about 2000 km over thirty days - representing one Vasaloppet a day (most famous cross country ski race). He rolls across the Arctic Polar Circle, meets interesting people and examines his own motivation in challenging himself and pushing his comfort zone.

programme.title: Hokkaido Japan by bike - Part 3 Eng
programme.desc: Our bikepacker friend Michele is exploring the Japanese island of Hokkaido. On the agenda: volcanoes, forests, wilderness, brown bears, fishing owls, the Pacific Ocean, and weather that isnt always kind. Episode 3.

programme.title: UIPM 2025 Obstacle World Championships
programme.desc: Beijing’s Olympic Centre turns into a proving ground as the UIPM Obstacle World Championships crown new stars across the 400 m, 3 K, and blistering 100 m sprint.

programme.title: The First Second - Michi Wohlleben
programme.desc: «The higher you raise the bar the further you fall down!”. Michi language is made of very strong, singular sentences, as sharpened as his climbing style. His sentences try to define himself, without worrying about himself, by thwarting clichés… but do not succeed in really finding himself. On the other hand his words create beautiful images that show Michis inspiration, fluidity, and pleasure in action. Through the discovery of his goals and his gamble with the risk, Michi mixes both quest and primal pleasure.

programme.title: International Temiscamingue Raid Eng
programme.desc: The International Temiscamingue Raid is the first stage event to be part of the Adventure Race World Series, an international series that specializes in adventure races and which brings together the best endurance athletes in the world. Last September, athletes from Brazil, Uruguay, Mexico, Finland and Canada and seven local teams from Temiscamingue participated in the Raid Témiscamingue.

programme.title: The First Second - Geraldine Fasnacht
programme.desc: When Geraldine, the bird woman puts on her mask, we know that the images of the pink wingsuit will be closer to poetry than adrenaline! Several snowboard world championship titles, more than 3200 jumps, but at the start, how do you decide to ride and fly all your life?

programme.title: 12th Longines Equestrian Beijing Masters 2025
programme.desc: China. Beijing. A city where history breathes through every stone and shimmer of steel. Here, where dynasties once rode across vast plains, a new kind of cavalry takes the stage riders of precision, courage, and grace. Each autumn, the National Stadium, the Bird’s Nest transforms. Where Olympic legends once soared, hooves now thunder. This is the Longines Beijing Masters — the heart of Asian equestrian sport, and a meeting place for the world’s finest.

programme.title: Spartan Beast World Championship 2025 Eng
programme.desc: Spartan is back again to the culturally rich and visually intoxicating dunes of Abu Dhabi, UAE for the 2025 Spartan World Championship hosted by Abu Dhabi Sports Council. The Spartan World Championship weekend will include a variety of different World Championship races. A select group of top elites will battle for the 3K Elite World Championship title, while Elite and Age Group racers looking for a more grueling challenge will take on the qualification-based 21K Beast Championships.

programme.title: Mongolia Horseback Archery World Championships 2023
programme.desc: For 2023, Mongolia and its capital Ulaanbaatar was brought in the spotlight of official horseback archery competition, that has grown a lot over the last few years in many places around the world. Everything started with the Spirit International HBA tournament in the beginning of September and this event would set the stage for the pinnacle one that was about to follow: the 2023 International Horse Archery Alliance World Championships.

programme.title: Cycling home from China Eng
programme.desc: Josh spent 4 months self filming his bike trip home from the Giant bike factory in Shanghai. During his 15 000 km trip between Shanghai China and Newcastle UK, he crossed 19 countries. A fantastic human adventure and a unique bike trip !

programme.title: The Outdoor Sports Show 2025 - Christmas Special Edition
programme.desc: We start this episode from Romania. In our previous episodes, we covered the exciting 2025 edition of Brasov Running Festival, highlighting the effort of the Elite 10k athletes. However, the Brasov Running Festival is much more than just the elite competitors. We then shift our focus to cycling, moving on to Turkey for another edition of LÉtape Türkiye by Tour de France. Moving from Turkey, we catch a flight to Croatia for Spartan Trail Dubrovnik. Since this is the last episode of the TV Show for 2025, we also got a glimpse of some of the most notable moments we enjoyed over the previous months.

programme.title: Hokkaido Japan by bike - Part 4 Eng
programme.desc: Our bikepacker friend Michele is exploring the Japanese island of Hokkaido. On the agenda: volcanoes, forests, wilderness, brown bears, fishing owls, the Pacific Ocean, and weather that isnt always kind. Episode 4.

programme.title: The First Second - Geraldine Fasnacht
programme.desc: When Geraldine, the bird woman puts on her mask, we know that the images of the pink wingsuit will be closer to poetry than adrenaline! Several snowboard world championship titles, more than 3200 jumps, but at the start, how do you decide to ride and fly all your life?

programme.title: Cape To Cape 2025 Eng
programme.desc: 800 riders have assembled for the 17th edition of the Australian Cape To Cape mountain bike stage race. Starting at Cape Leeuwin lighthouse and finishing four days later up at Cape Naturaliste, the course makes its way through a network of trails along the coast, through National Parks, forest, farm lands, mountain bike parks, and bush before heading up to the northern cape of the South West WA region. Roughly 200km and 2,500m of climbing in total, each day’s riding is between 34km and 59km and has its own special terrain and environment to keep things interesting with a mix of fast flowing single trail, farm tracks, groomed downhill trails and fire trails.

programme.title: Santos Tour Down Under Women 2026
programme.desc: 9th edition of the Womens Tour Down Under, which is the part of the 2026 UCI Womens World Tour.

programme.title: Cro Race 2025
programme.desc: The 2025 CRO Race is a road cycling stage race (6 stages - 900 km) in Croatia held between 30 September and 5 October 2025. It is the tenth edition of the Tour of Croatia since its revival in 2015 and the sixth under the CRO Race name. The race is rated as a category 2.1 event on the 2025 UCI Europe Tour calendar

programme.title: Santos Tour Down Under Men 2026
programme.desc: Australia’s greatest cycling race is back to launch the international cycling season. South Australia is celebrated at its best, taking the peloton across 6 stages. The 2026 Santos Tour Down Under mens race features a tough climb - Knotts Hill. Each stage pays homage to the events history while exploring great landscapes, promising thrilling challenges for the riders.

programme.title: Inside Desertus Bikus Eng
programme.desc: Josh partcipates to Desertus Bikus, an ultra cycling race that crosses Spain and Portugal starting in Hasparren in the Basque Country and finishing in Setubal Portugal. Josh is cycling during 1400 km across desert areas, villages, gravel tracks and asphalt roads.

programme.title: 2025 Aus Cycling MTB Enduro National Championships
programme.desc: A rain-soaked Collie, Western Australia, becomes the stage for Australia’s premier Enduro showdown, where world-class Wambenger Trails and the iconic Wellington Dam mural frame a weekend of grit, flow and community. Across Juniors, Masters, Adaptive and E-bike fields, riders wrestle slick rock, pea gravel and long liaison climbs as stories of resilience emerge. The result is a kinetic, human-centred portrait of Australian MTB: fast, muddy, inclusive, and unforgettable.

programme.title: GKA Freestyle Kite World Cup Taiba - Brazil 2025
programme.desc: The second and final call of the GKA Freestyle season is set to play out in the sumptuous conditions of Brazil’s Taíba lagoon, where the 2025 world champions will be crowned. The world championship titles are in the balance after the opening stop in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates, several weeks ago, ended inconclusively when the wind declined to play ball for the freestylers. That effectively makes the GKA Freestyle Kite World Cup Taíba 2025 a one-stop world championship for the 2025 titles, leaving no margin for slip-ups from leading contenders, who are all in Brazil.

programme.title: SFT Wake Foil E-Foil World Cup Abu Dhabi 2025
programme.desc: Abu Dhabi, the capital of the United Arab Emirates, will make history this autumn as it hosts the GWA Wingfoil World Cup for the first time, marking the grand finale of the 2025 FreeFly-Slalom season. Leading the charge are two-time defending world champions, Nia Suardiaz, of Spain, and Francesco Cappuzzo, of Italy, who head to Abu Dhabi leading the rankings. With the season’s final stop still wide open, both athletes will need flawless performances to secure their third consecutive titles.

programme.title: GKA Hydrofoil Big Air World Cup Abu Dhabi 2025
programme.desc: Abu Dhabi will host the GKA Kite World Tour for the first time, bringing back-to-back World Cups in Hydrofoil Big Air and Freestyle to Fahid Island, Abu Dhabi’s newest coastal wellness destination and the world’s first Fitwel-certified island, offering 11kms of coastline.

programme.title: GKA Freestyle World Cup Abu Dhabi 2025
programme.desc: Abu Dhabi will host the GKA Kite World Tour for the first time, bringing back-to-back World Cups in Hydrofoil Big Air and Freestyle to Fahid Island, Abu Dhabi’s newest coastal wellness destination and the world’s first Fitwel-certified island, offering 11kms of coastline.

programme.title: Nastro Rosa Tour 2025 Eng
programme.desc: The Marina Militare Nastro Rosa Tour returns in 2025 for its fifth edition, offering a unique journey that blends high-level competition with Italy’s maritime culture and coastal beauty. Since its debut in 2021, the Tour has grown into more than a sailing event—it has become a travelling festival of the sea, connecting athletes, coastal cities, and local communities in a shared celebration of sport, heritage, and discovery.

programme.title: Changing Channels
programme.desc: Gerrard Gosens is set to become the first totally blind person to attempt the daunting 34+ km swim from Dover in the UK to Cape Gris-Nez in France. Battling the cold and unpredictable waters of the English Channel, Gerrard faces not only the rough conditions but also the need to swim in synchronization with his team of guide swimmers, Hayden, Phil, Jo, Rosie, Alexis, and Sarah by his side.

programme.title: All The Way Eng
programme.desc: From award-winning documentary filmmaker Carl Eneroth at Sthlm Social Innovation Lab comes "All the Way". A heart-pounding, intimate and mind expanding portrait of Swimrun team Pontus Lindberg and George Bjälkemo, as they prepare for their ultimate challenge… winning the 75 km ÖtillÖ Swimrun World Championships in the Stockholm archipelago… in trail shoes and a wetsuit.

programme.title: Oman Downwinder Eng
programme.desc: The Oman Downwinder movie intents to show Oman and its conditions for wind powered sports. It is a movie that explores behaviours, the Omani hospitality, the landscape and attractions of Oman within the downwinder route and not, exclusively, a movie about kitesufing/Wingfoiling. The movie was designed to explore the experience of professional kiteboarders/wingfoilers (Ambassadors) interacting with amateur riders based in Oman on this 7-day trip along the coast. Apart from the Ambassadors, the movie also explores the Oman Kitesurfing community via local actors and their experiences during the downwinder.

programme.title: The First Second - Armel Le Cl ac h E
programme.desc: Armel Le Cléach creates his victories thanks to a strong relationship with the whole team of which he is the extension ... But for this navigator engaged in a daunting battle with the ocean on a giant 32-meter trimaran, each course towards a new start is a new battle with the unknown, with his own will and with his primary adversary: himself.

programme.title: Moana Waiwai - The Film
programme.desc: Moana Waiwai or The Great Ocean in Maori, is about the FreeSwim journey of wahine (woman) Ally Davey as she swims 70km of open ocean around the stunning Coromandel coastline over three days to raise awareness for the protection of New Zealands oceans. It does more than encapsulate stunning vistas and highlight the extraordinary New Zealand environment. It inspires people to be aware of the natural beauty that surrounds them.

programme.title: One Water Race 2025 - The Film Eng
programme.desc: One Water Race is an endurance race based on Running, Swimming and Orienteering. 10 mixed teams of 4 athletes have to cross the Stockholm-Sweden archipelago from North to South in a non-stop 250 km race with 200 km of running and 50 km of swimming. They have to completely handle their navigation including in the darkness.

programme.title: GKA Kite-Surf World Cup Dakhla - Morocco 2025
programme.desc: A full roster of 28 men and 16 women, from a total of 16 countries around the world, are set to join the line-up in Dakhla for five days of intense action that could have a key bearing on who takes the titles. Reigning world champions, France’s Capucine Delannoy and Brazil’s Gabriel Benetton, top the Kite-Surf rankings as they head to the season’s penultimate stop in Dakhla, Morocco, on the Sahara desert’s coastline.

programme.title: GKA Kite-Surf World Cup Taiba - Brazil 2025
programme.desc: Taíba, Brazil, host the final stop of the GKA Kite World Tour 2025. The world’s top riders will take to Taíba’s powerful Atlantic waves for four days of action-packed competition that will determine the men’s and women’s world titles. The event marks the thrilling conclusion to a season that has already visited Cape Verde, Dakhla, and Sylt.

programme.title: Summiting Mt Sneffels in Colorado Eng
programme.desc: Mount Sneffels is a prominent mountain near Ouray, Colorado in the United States which is over 14,000 feet high, more than 4,300 metres. Audree had never climbed a 14er, so we decided to try reach its summit while on a road trip through Colorado in late-July.

programme.title: Lekkarod 2025
programme.desc: Depuis 10 ans, la Lekkarod est une course majeure du mushing en Europe. Affiliée aux fédérations nationale FFST et internationale IFSS, elle est une étape de la Coupe du Monde. Chaque année, une centaine de mushers et leurs chiens prennent le départ des 9 étapes de la Lekkarod, ou de celles des Trophées !For the past 10 years, the Lekkarod has been a major mushing race in Europe. Affiliated with the national FFST and international IFSS federations, it is a stage of the World Cup. Each year, around a hundred mushers and their dogs take part in the 9 stages of the Lekkarod, or those of the Trophies!

programme.title: Aussie 8
programme.desc: Aussie 8 is the adventure of 3 friends who decided to climb the 8 tallest mountains in 8 Australian states in 8 days. To make this possible, they had to put together and respect a very strict timing and logistic organisation.

programme.title: Nendaz Backcountry Invitational 2025
programme.desc: Nestled in the heart of the Swiss Alps, the Nendaz Backcountry Invitational 2025 is one of the most exciting events on the freeride calendar. This unique competition brings together some of the world’s top backcountry athletes, showcasing their incredible skills and creativity in untouched snow.

programme.title: A Feather in the West
programme.desc: In September 2019, a team of talented Irish climbers [Chloe Condron, Kevin Kilroy, Michelle OLoughlin and Conor McGovern] travelled to the small island of Owey to explore sea cliffs that local guidebook writer Iain Miller claims, have “enough new routing potential to last at least twelve lifetimes”. ‘A Feather in the West’ is a film about their trad climbing experiences and the relatively niche pursuit of first ascents, set on the Wild Atlantic Way, off the west coast of County Donegal. (Special thanks to Pertex)

programme.title: Shaq & Cedric ''The Entertainer'' Present The All Star Comedy Jam
programme.desc: Shaq & Cedric ''The Entertainer'' Present The All Star Comedy Jam featuring Tommy Davidson, DeRay Davis, Aries Spears, and Kevin Hart. Hosted By Cedric "The Entertainer".

programme.title: Hannibal Buress Goes to Scotland
programme.desc: Here is comedian and actor Hannibal Buress as he is filmed on stage and during his trip to Scotland in this docu-film.

programme.title: Todd Rexx "Beautiful Mess" Comedy Special
programme.desc: Here is comedian Todd Rexx's "Beautiful Mess" Comedy Special.

programme.title: z-Marcus D. Wiley's "The Church Shoe Fits"
programme.desc: Marcus D. Wiley's comedy special titled The Church Shoe Fits.

programme.title: Not Another Black Movie
programme.desc: Not Another Black Movie stars Damon Williams (Bad Boys of Comedy, Comic View, BET LIVE, The Tom Joyner Morning Show), Janet Hubert (The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air), Rodney Perry (The Monique Show, Who's Got Jokes) Jay Davis (Not Another Zombie Movie, Shots Fired), and Leon Rogers (WGCI, Comic View, Bad Boys of Comedy). - Not Another Black Movie is not only a spoof of a genre often associated with Tyler Perry films, but a satirical look at family dysfunction as well. Written by Jay Davis and Directed by Donte "Diesel" Williams, Not Another Black Movie addresses issues that effect many families whether they be rich or poor, black or white. Although we poke fun at some of the stereotypical roles portrayed in this genre, we hope to shed some light on problems that plague many families while giving you a good laugh.

programme.desc: Here is an early comedy special of Jamie Foxx, titled "I Might Need Security" plus bonus footage.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S3
programme.desc: Jonathan begint zijn reis in Californië met een ruige 4x4-doorsteek door de Mojave-woestijn, vol spookstadjes en gevaren. Uiteindelijk maakt hij zijn weg naar Las Vegas, waar een geheel nieuwe reeks avonturen op hem wacht.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S3
programme.desc: Jonathan onderzoekt het concept van duurzaam toerisme in Cambodja; hij gaat op een junglepatrouille met Wildlife Alliance en belicht het verhaal van de illegale stroperij- en handelindustrie.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1
programme.desc: De broers bereiken hun doel door op motorfietsen naar het hart van Nicaragua te rijden. Ze doorkruisen de jungle naar afgelegen stranden aan de Pacifische kust en reizen landinwaarts door Spaanse koloniale steden, lokale dorpen en het immense vulkanische eiland Ometepe.

programme.title: Epic Trails S1
programme.desc: Eric Hanson gaat heli-hiken en verkent grotten terwijl hij Canada’s eerste en meest populaire nationale park en het naburige Lake Louise ontdekt.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1
programme.desc: Bill trekt door eindeloze modder, dichte vegetatie en steile bergen om oog in oog te staan met onze machtige verwanten – de gorilla’s. Hij volgt ook het leven en ontdekt de restanten van het kamp van een van zijn helden: Dian Fossey.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1
programme.desc: Botswana is een droom voor natuurliefhebbers, met enorme kuddes olifanten, reusachtige groepen nijlpaarden en enkele van de grootste leeuwentroepen ter wereld. Het is ook de thuisbasis van de Victoriawatervallen – de grootste waterval ter wereld.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1
programme.desc: Ash’ reis langs de Chinese Muur begint op het meest oostelijke punt, bij een eeuwenoud deel dat bekendstaat als de Chu-Muur. Daarna reist Ash naar de Shaolintempel in de stad Dengfeng om kennis te maken met hun eeuwenoude gebruiken.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1
programme.desc: Vanaf Old Dragon’s Head trekt Ash westwaarts, waar hij een Muurbeschermer ontmoet die zijn leven heeft gewijd aan het behoud van dit iconische bouwwerk. Daarna maakt hij zich op voor een onverwacht avontuur: duiken bij de onder water gelopen resten van de Chinese Muur.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1
programme.desc: Ash is aangekomen in Peking, waar hij Terry Townsend ontmoet om meer te leren over natuurbescherming in de regio rond de Chinese Muur. Ook ontmoet hij twee andere Muurbeschermers en proeft hij lokale lekkernijen in het dorp Shi Xia.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S5
programme.desc: Jonathan blikt terug op een door de pandemie getroffen productiejaar en deelt ongeziene beelden, inzichten en momenten achter de schermen uit seizoen 5 tot nu toe.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S3
programme.desc: In een land waar werkelijk alles mogelijk is, is Jonathan niet verbaasd vrouwen in uiteenlopende rollen en posities aan te treffen, maar de extremen zijn schokkend divers en volledig onverwacht.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S3
programme.desc: Italië in de zomer is toeristisch tot op het bot... maar kan Jonathan nog steeds het minder bewandelde pad vinden?

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2
programme.desc: Josh verkent de buurt in Armenië en de hoofdstad Yerevan, bezoekt enkele verlaten Sovjet gebouwen, een breifabriek en een luxe hotel.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2
programme.desc: Josh is terug in Gary, Indiana, voor een lokale verkenningstocht. Samen met vrienden bezoekt hij een voormalige bank, het gedenkauditorium en treinstation Union.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2
programme.desc: In Epic Exploring: Going Local wordt Zagreb, Kroatië bezocht. Cody vuurt een kanon af in de oude toren, verkent een nooit afgebouwd universiteitsziekenhuis en een politiekschool.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1
programme.desc: Stel je een kroegentocht voor langs 26 pubs, verspreid over 7 dagen en 60 mijl! Tijdens een traditionele ramble door de adembenemende Yorkshire Dales in Noord-Engeland trekken de broers door heidevelden, dalen, pieken en valleien – met benen én lever nog intact.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1
programme.desc: Vanuit Marrakesh nemen de broers een reeks lokale Berber-taxi’s over het High Atlasgebergte en dalen af in de Draa-vallei, totdat de weg eindigt aan de rand van de eindeloze zandzee van de Sahara, waar ze een verborgen schat begraven.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1
programme.desc: Op weg naar het uiterste noorden, naar de Arctis, om de traditionele cultuur en het indrukwekkende leven van de Inuit te ontdekken, vergezellen de broers een oudere en een jonge jager op een 200 mijl lange sneeuwscootertocht over het barre land en bevroren zee-ijs.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1
programme.desc: Fietsen is doorgaans een veilige en ontspannen bezigheid – totdat je het doet in de wildernis van Kenia, tussen leeuwen, olifanten en buffels.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1
programme.desc: Bill had twee wilde iconen die hij per se wilde meemaken. De eerste: de grootste hagedis ter wereld – de Komodovaraan. Tussen deze reusachtige beesten lopen was op zijn zachtst gezegd zenuwslopend. De andere: de enige mensaap van Azië – de orang-oetan.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1
programme.desc: In zijn zwaarste uitdaging tot nu toe waagt Ash zich aan Eagle’s Neck – een berucht steil en gevaarlijk stuk van de Chinese Muur. Maar eerst ontmoet hij technologie-experts die helpen de Muur digitaal in kaart te brengen, met als doel haar te beschermen.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1
programme.desc: Langs het westelijke deel van de Muur reist Ash naar Binnen-Mongolië om daar een nomadenfamilie te ontmoeten en zich te wagen aan Mongoolse worsteltechnieken. Hij hoopt het Naadam-festival bij te wonen, waar paardrijden – een belangrijk onderdeel van de Mongoolse cultuur – centraal staat.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1
programme.desc: Ash trekt de woestijn in om Wu Xinlei te ontmoeten, een survival-expert. Hij wil begrijpen hoe het voor de mensen moet zijn geweest die de Chinese Muur in dit afgelegen en onverbiddelijke landschap bouwden.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S5
programme.desc: Jonathan blikt terug op een door de pandemie getroffen productiejaar en deelt ongeziene beelden, inzichten en momenten achter de schermen uit seizoen 5 tot nu toe.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S3
programme.desc: In het adembenemende Lago di Garda waagt Jonathan zich opnieuw aan een paraglidemanoeuvre die hem vorig jaar bijna het leven kostte. Even verderop, in de stad Bolzano, sluit hij zich aan bij een eliteteam voor helikopterreddingen om mee te doen aan reddingsoefeningen – maar een echte noodsituatie dreigt zijn missie te doen ontsporen. Bij zijn vertrek kiest onze presentator voor een zenuwslopende route over de majestueuze Dolomieten, helemaal tot in Zwitserland, om daar een stad te bezoeken die letterlijk met de klok meedraait rond één enkel doel.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S3
programme.desc: In een land dat niet bekendstaat om spanning, staat er iets groots te gebeuren. Jonathan duikt in Vlaanderen om West-Europa’s minst gewaardeerde regio te verkennen.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S3
programme.desc: Jonathan stort zich in Londen voor een stedelijk avontuur en verkent de subculturen van deze diverse stad. Een trip die naaktpoëzie, graffitispuitende grime-rappers en burlesque in zijn puurste vorm omvat.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2
programme.desc: Local Exploring gaat naar de uithoeken van de wereld, waarbij Josh naar pooleiland Svalbard gaat om de buurt van Barentsburg en de Arctische Oceaan te bezoeken.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2
programme.desc: Vanuit Tirana, de hoofdstad van oud Sovjetsatellieteiland Albanië, begint Josh weer een avontuur door de buurt en bezoekt bunkers en een verborgen ziekenhuis en hij duikt in een piratengrot.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2
programme.desc: Epic Exploring verkent de buurt weer en Cody gaat naar Lüderitz, Namibië, en verlaat daat de gebaande paden, helemaal door de woestijn heen, om naar spookstad Pamona te gaan.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1
programme.desc: De broers doorkruisen het onderling verbonden netwerk van waterwegen per veerboot. Van een garnalenbaron tot eenvoudige vissers, van eeuwenoude tempelruïnes tot anonieme chai wallahs – ze banen zich een weg naar Kushtia, de thuisbasis van het heiligdom van Guru Lalone Shaw.

programme.title: Travel Quest S2
programme.desc: Nieuw-Zuid-Wales is de thuisbasis van Sydney, met het iconische Opera House en Harbour Bridge. Bill probeert de gigantische stalen constructie te beklimmen om de stad van bovenaf te bewonderen.

programme.title: Travel Quest S2
programme.desc: In deze aflevering reis je letterlijk naar enkele van de meest afgelegen plekken ter wereld. Eerst een bezoek aan Siberië… een van de meest onherbergzame gebieden op aarde – al blijken veel van de angstaanjagende verhalen grotendeels mythen te zijn.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1
programme.desc: Ash bevindt zich in de laatste etappe van zijn reis langs de Chinese Muur. Nadat hij de bouwtechnieken van de Muur heeft bestudeerd, trekt hij verder de Gobiwoestijn in, naar het betoverende Crescent Lake – een prachtige oase tussen zandduinen.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1
programme.desc: Na een weerzien met een oude vriend van de Chu-muur bezoekt Ash enkele indrukwekkende stenen structuren – zowel natuurlijke als door mensenhanden gemaakt – in het Yardang Nationaal Park en in Xiaofang City. Met een laatste telefoontje naar huis komt er een einde aan zijn reis langs de Chinese Muur.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1
programme.desc: Na een weerzien met een oude vriend van de Chu-muur bezoekt Ash enkele indrukwekkende stenen structuren – zowel natuurlijke als door mensenhanden gemaakt – in het Yardang Nationaal Park en in Xiaofang City. Met een laatste telefoontje naar huis komt er een einde aan zijn reis langs de Chinese Muur.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S3
programme.desc: Jonathan reist over de oceaan naar het land van zijn voorouders om de eigen overtuigingen, legendes en sporten van de Britse eilanden te onderzoeken – een reis die begint met een vampier op een kerkhof en eindigt in een zombie-apocalyps.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S3
programme.desc: Jonathan reist over de oceaan naar het land van zijn voorouders om de eigen overtuigingen, legendes en sporten van de Britse eilanden te onderzoeken – een reis die begint met een vampier op een kerkhof en eindigt in een zombie-apocalyps.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S3
programme.desc: Jonathan betreedt Europa’s modehoofdstad om te achterhalen wat het precies “très chic” maakt. Terwijl hij in contact komt met modellenbureaus en ontwerpers, blijkt er zich onder hem iets duisters af te spelen in de eeuwenoude catacomben – een ondergronds doolhof van honderden kilometers met beenderen van de doden, eigenaardige objecten achtergelaten door ‘cataphielen’ en een geheimzinnige vampiergemeenschap.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2
programme.desc: Local Exploring in Tokio is compleet anders dan anders. Josh en Lexi Limitless bezoeken de drukke straten, een schreeuwend Monster Café en een verlaten 'liefdeshotel'.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S4
programme.desc: Sashi verkent de beste luxe resorts van de Malediven, van ondergrondse wijnkelders tot diners op zandbanken en onderwaterrestaurants – culinaire luxe op zijn best.

programme.desc: Jonathan verkent Kalighat in Kolkata, studeert dans en goddelijkheid, ontdekt de geschiedenis van Brits Oost-India en bezoekt de enige Chinatown van India.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S3
programme.desc: Het Parijse avontuur gaat verder: Boven de grond, na de catacomben, leert een parkour-expert onze gast de kunst van het bewegen door een stedelijk landschap door zijn innerlijke aapjongen naar boven te halen, en terwijl de Technoparade door de Parijse straten rolt, maakt hij gebruik van zijn connectie met DJ Nick V om het meest electrische moment neer te zetten.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S3
programme.desc: Een ontmoeting met een vrouw die in het geheim 3.000 Hollywoodfilms heeft getranscribeerd tijdens een onderdrukkend regime, inspireert Jonathan om zijn eigen film te maken. Met een klein budget en een lokale cast verkent hij Saksische kastelen, zijrivieren van de Donau en vervallen gebouwen om een spannende actiefilm te regisseren.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S3
programme.desc: Naast het ‘film’-project duikt Jonathan dieper in internetchatrooms vanuit zelden vertoonde perspectieven en strijdt hij om zijn plek in een sport die wordt gezien als de lang verloren voorloper van honkbal.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1
programme.desc: Op het zuidelijkste puntje van Afrika ontmoet Xander een oude vriend om het unieke landschap van een kustplaats te verkennen en te genieten van de vele aangeboden faciliteiten.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1
programme.desc: In Stilbaai nemen Xander en zijn team deel aan een sjamanistisch ritueel voordat ze aan een intimiderend avontuur beginnen. In Canada leert Adam een lesje over zelfbeheersing.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1
programme.desc: Terwijl Xander en z'n team van Mosselbaai naar Pinnacle Point reizen, hebben ze het naar hun zin bij een prachtig ziplineparcours, de beste golfbaan van Zuid-Afrika en tijdens een echte spadag.

programme.title: Cooks on Fire S2
programme.desc: De drie finalisten strijden in twee rondes. Eerst een live fire-uitdaging waarbij ze een volledig lam Asado-stijl moeten bereiden, gevolgd door een barbecue-degustatie om indruk te maken op de legendarische chef-kok Al Brown.

programme.title: Food Unknown S1
programme.desc: Finland is dat ene Noordse land dat zelden op de wereldkaart van de gastronomie verschijnt. Maar terwijl niemand keek, hebben de terughoudende Finnen stilletjes hun wildplukcultuur verfijnd en verweven in een unieke keuken. Jonathan Legg doorkruist het hele land om de Finse gastronomie te doorgronden – en de filosofie van de beste chefs te begrijpen. Van verbluffende gerechten met lokale ingrediënten in Helsinki tot een expeditie in Lapland om alles te leren over wildplukken en de Finse delicatesse: rendier!

programme.title: Food Unknown S1
programme.desc: Het is de geboorteplaats van Halloween, maar de geesten en griezels die de wereld hebben doorkruist, hebben weinig belangstelling gewekt voor de Ierse keuken. Jonathan stapt op een klassieke motor en doorkruist een land vol mystieke tradities, uitbundige locals en iconische landschappen. ’s Werelds meest onweerstaanbare pubcultuur trekt hem aan, grensconflicten drijven hem weg en duistere legendes lokken hem verder. Een avontuur doordrenkt van regen, sagen en het eten van voorouders uit vervlogen tijden.

programme.title: Travel Quest S2
programme.desc: Australië is een reusachtig land met diverse ecosystemen die het tot een van de interessantste ter wereld maken. Deze aflevering van Travel Quest verkent het noorden en het verre zuiden van dit land... het grootste “eiland” ter wereld.

programme.title: Travel Quest S2
programme.desc: Er is één plek ter wereld waar de machtige ijsbeer - de grootste carnivoor ter wereld - in grote aantallen te vinden is gedurende een zeer specifieke periode van het jaar... Churchill Manitoba, Canada.

programme.title: Travel Quest S2

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S3
programme.desc: Jonathan betreedt Europa’s armste land met een doel: hij reist naar de weinig bekende afgescheiden Sovjetrepubliek Transnistrië met een ‘pakketje’ voor een vriend. programme.title: Road Less Traveled S3
programme.desc: Jonathan sluit het seizoen af met een expeditie rond het thema isolement: een reis die hem van Arunachal Pradesh in India,verdergaat naar de Dolomieten in Italië en eindigt helemaal onderaan de wereld, in Antarctica.

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S1

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S1

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1

programme.title: Food Unknown S1

Terwijl hij schorpioen-taco’s proeft en louche markten in San Juan ontwijkt, leert hij over de mysterieuze wereld van heilige dranken zoals pulque en mezcal, die inmiddels tot sociale genotsmiddelen zijn getransformeerd. Zijn reis voert hem ook naar Oaxaca, waar hij de geheimen van de legendarische molesaus ontdekt. programme.title: Heavy Lifting S1

programme.title: Heavy Lifting S1
